Normalunmounted tick resets attachTime, not all movementstate. Packet/native riding implementation not read.

Model resetToDefaultPose first; eyeidle bob, tailidle flaps/walk and bodybob always. bodyY +=8. Groundgait weakens by1-flyProgress*.2 whenflyProgress!=5, drives six paired planar appendages in phasegroups0,-2.5,-5 plus sheath/body. No normal playerarm template.

Model tentacleProgress=(5-limbSwingAmount*10)*flyProgress*.2 computed before gaitattenuation; notclamped, becomesnegative forlimbAmount>.5. Scales laterbodyY-6 and appendageZ±45 byprogress/5. Do not describe as universally0..5foldblend.

PassengerbodyX+pi/2 and bodyYrotation+pi/2*index, sheathYscale .85+.15sin(age), collarYoffset, capsidpulse, mouthYmotion; tentacleProgressforced-2. Nonpassenger explicitsheath/capsidscale1 and bodyX -=phagePitch*flyProgress*.2. Thus owned scaleexit exists, independent of physics reset.

Entitytick sets PhagePitch-90 unconditionally BEFORE prevPhagePitch capture, then later own speedbased pitchupdates. Passenger rideTick overridespitch0 after tick. This source order matters; do not claim stable previouspitch interpolation or purely velocityderivedpitch.

Model gets Minecraft.getCameraEntity and derives eyeY from camerarelativeXZ minusbodyyaw, eyeX from clampedcameraheightdiff pluspitchcompensation. netHeadYaw/headPitch unused. Client-camera eye tracking is cosmetic, not server target/observer test, especially multiplayer.
